[Review Number 478] I play some Graveyard Keeper 2 and give my opinion throughout... How does the game compare to similar cozy farming sim game like Stardew Valley? Is it worth buying or playing for $25?

You can support the channel at http://patreon.com/LFP or https://streamelements.com/lfpgaming/tip and you can also buy Steam games DIRECTLY from developers at https://www.nexus.gg/lfpgaming

PC Specs: Nvidia RTX 5080 GPU with AMD Ryzen 5 5700X3D CPU and 64GB DDR4 RAM

0:00 Verdict

Steam description: "The most inaccurate medieval cemetery sim is back! Restore The Town, manage the graveyard, automate production, lead your undead army into battle and turn the zombie problem into a thriving business! Graveyard Keeper 2 is the grotesque sequel that's deeper than six feet, and more unhinged than ever!"
